comment: Stability and administration (GDD 7.3; stage 4f PR 3, ADR 0023). Stability 0-100 = the mood of the civilization's settlements weighed by the people of each stratum times the stratum's political influence (strataInfluence in governments.json; until strata have their own mood a stratum's mood is its settlement's), plus the government's stabilityBonus, minus: an overloaded administration (overloadPenaltyPer100Percent points when the points used are twice the government's administration, proportional, at most overloadMaxPenalty), a succession crisis (crisisPenalty), anarchy for anarchyYears after a change of government (anarchyPenalty; no state decisions meanwhile) and a capital fallen to an enemy (capitalLostPenalty for capitalLostYears); these three count for the part of the civilization's step they last (a 5-year crisis in a 50-year step counts a tenth). Administration: every settlement uses adminPerSettlement points plus adminPerRoadCost per point of road cost from the capital (movement cost of the cells on the cheapest land route, searched up to roadSearchCost; farther or across water counts as roadSearchCost). Loyalty of a settlement = stability minus loyaltyPer10RoadCost per 10 points of road cost, so distant settlements break away first. Revolts (stage 4f PR 4): below revoltBelow a revolt breaks out with revoltPerMillePerYear per mille a year (over the years of the civilization's step); after one, none for revoltCalmYears. The rebels are the settlements other than the capital with loyalty below secessionLoyaltyBelow; the largest group of them linked by trade.json linkCells, if it has secessionMinPeople people and the game has fewer than maxCivilizations civilizations, breaks away as a new civilization: a daughter language, a government other than the parent's, character traits within secessionCharacterShift of the parent's, the parent's technologies and map memory; the parent remembers the secession (relations.json). Drift (stage 5b): even in a calm state the rebels (most of all the settlements beyond the government's reach, governments.json, whose loyalty is 0) break away the same way with driftPerMillePerYear per mille a year, outside the calm after a revolt. Otherwise the revolt is a coup: a new leader and another government (with its anarchy). Below unrestBelow unrest begins: the unrestEffect (effects.json) lowers the output of every settlement by unrestOutputPercentPerPoint percent per point below.
